mapper.insert: insert into dish(name, category_id, price, image, description, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user,status) values(#{name}, #{categoryId}, #{price}, #{image}, #{description}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser},#{status})
mapper.delete:
delete from dish where id in
#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT d.name as name, SUM(od.number) as number FROM order_detail od INNER JOIN orders o ON od.order_id = o.id INNER JOIN dish d ON od.dish_id = d.id WHERE o.status = #{status} AND o.order_time BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end} AND d.name IS NOT NULL AND d.name != '' GROUP BY d.id, d.name ORDER BY number DESC LIMIT 10
